LanguageData.RMush_AteCauliflower.stages.0.label: cauliflower flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteCauliflower.stages.0.descriptio: Every crisp bite brings out more nutty flavor. For something shaped like flower petals, it has quite a bite.
LanguageData.RMush_AtePurpleBlewit.stages.0.label: purple blewit flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AtePurpleBlewit.stages.0.descripti: A little sweetness peeks through that rich mushroom aroma. What an unexpected little treat.
LanguageData.RMush_AteBlackTruffle.stages.0.label: rich truffle aroma
LanguageData.RMush_AteBlackTruffle.stages.0.descripti: That deep aroma fills my mouth. For a moment, my ordinary meal feels like a lavish feast.
LanguageData.RMush_AtePorcini.stages.0.label: nutty porcini flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AtePorcini.stages.0.description: There's a gentle nutty flavor hiding in that thick flesh. It feels like I've brought home a little treasure from the woods.
LanguageData.RMush_AteMorel.stages.0.label: morel flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteMorel.stages.0.description: That little honeycomb of a cap has a springy bite. Its mild flavor lets me take my time enjoying the texture.
LanguageData.RMush_AteBlackTrumpet.stages.0.label: black trumpet flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteBlackTrumpet.stages.0.descripti: So much rich flavor hidden in such a thin piece. This little trumpet certainly makes itself heard in my mouth.
LanguageData.RMush_AteGiantPuffball.stages.0.label: mild puffball flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteGiantPuffball.stages.0.descript: How can something this huge be so soft? It's like biting into a cloud with a gentle mushroom flavor.
LanguageData.RMush_AteIndigoMilkcap.stages.0.label: indigo milkcap flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteIndigoMilkcap.stages.0.descript: I thought the color was the unusual part, but that earthy flavor has depth too. I close my eyes and feel as if I'm sitting in the woods.
LanguageData.RMush_AteVeiledStinkhorn.stages.0.label: veiled stinkhorn texture
LanguageData.RMush_AteVeiledStinkhorn.stages.0.descri: Smooth as silk, then a little crunch. There's more going on in this bite than I expected.
LanguageData.RMush_AteShaggyInkcap.stages.0.label: shaggy inkcap flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteShaggyInkcap.stages.0.descripti: As I bite into the tender flesh, its flavor spreads through my mouth like a little burst of ink.
LanguageData.RMush_AteLobster.stages.0.label: lobster mushroom texture
LanguageData.RMush_AteLobster.stages.0.description: That thick, firm flesh makes every bite feel like a piece of lobster.
